questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: A variety of hostels and apartments

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Some housing options have meal plans, while other have a shared kitchen

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Try to get housing in Utown with AC - I lived at pgp without AC, which was pretty horrible

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You have to apply to courses beforehand, but you can change them when you are closer to start

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Normal support, which is pretty fast

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I didn’t get all of the classes i wanted at first, but applied for other classes later so I just changed some of them

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Don’t worry if you don’t get all of your classes at first

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The level is generally the same as UCPH, but the syllabus is much bigger. For the courses I had it was around 2-3 x the syllabus at UCPH

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
How long were you on exchange? *
Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Transnational Law, Multinational Enterprises and International Law, IP Commercialisation and Fashion Law

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: If you are interested in IP I would recommend both Fashion Law and IP Commercialisation. Fashion Law is probably the best course I’ve ever had.
